summary: Executed backend pytest regression (10 tests) and multi-pass UI checks on preview URL. Core package, learn hub, privacy/legal, consent, unsubscribe safety, contact submit, and responsive layout passed. Stripe paid-completion and post-payment onboarding could not be fully verified due hosted-checkout anti-bot friction.

ui_bugs.issue: For pending sessions with invalid/missing access, page remained in 'Confirming your payment' state for extended time during automation instead of clearly transitioning to pending/error within expected UX window.

integration_issues.flow: Stripe hosted checkout -> paid return -> onboarding
integration_issues.issue: Could start checkout and reach Stripe-hosted page, but automated card completion was blocked by Stripe/hCaptcha challenge in preview automation; full paid redirect and paid-gated onboarding visibility could not be conclusively validated in this run.

issues: Duplicate canonical tags detected (one static canonical from public/index.html and one dynamic canonical from SEO component), which can dilute canonical signaling.

action_items: Manually complete one Stripe test payment in browser (4242...) to validate paid return + onboarding CTA visibility end-to-end without automation bot friction.
Harden PaymentSuccess state handling so invalid onboarding access cannot leave users in prolonged checking state.
Remove static canonical from frontend/public/index.html (or ensure only one canonical tag per route).
critical_code_review_comments: SEO canonical duplication: static canonical in index.html conflicts with dynamic route canonical from SEO component.
PaymentSuccess happy path assumes valid onboarding access when paid; failed access response currently lacks explicit fallback UI state in the paid branch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: home header wordmark without header image logo, exact AUD package prices, checkout initiation, consent reject/accept behavior (analytics suppressed then enabled), all five learn cards/articles and canonical host metadata, Terms/Privacy/footer links, sitemap canonical host + required learn/terms URLs, unsubscribe missing-token safety, returning-offer repeat-visit visibility, contact submit best-effort, and no carousel-loop warning. Pending: complete Stripe paid flow + onboarding 4-step submission end-to-end with a real interactive browser session.
rca of the issue: 1) Stripe completion gap: automation run reaches Stripe checkout but hCaptcha/anti-bot challenge blocks deterministic scripted completion. Mitigation: perform one manual paid-path verification in a real browser session and record returned /payment/success state + onboarding unlock. 2) Duplicate canonical: root canonical is hardcoded in public/index.html while SEO component injects per-route canonical, producing multiple canonicals on article pages. Mitigation: keep canonical only in route-aware SEO component. 3) Payment success prolonged checking: pending/invalid-access path observed lingering in checking during test windows. Mitigation: add deterministic timeout/fallback UI when onboarding-access fetch is non-200 or when polling exceeds UX threshold.
